evidence.says: Script Extender declares eoc::WeaponSetComponent::WeaponSet at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Components.h:148): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code. WeaponSetType is an enumeration of the extender's.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types), also in the queries of the equipment visuals of the client
on Astarion on the level Basic_Level_A WeaponSet reads Ranged

survey.from: Script Extender's declarations (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Components.h:148, kind component), by gatekit symbols se-layouts on 2026-11-14
survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
